mentions.name: PennyPost
mentions.description: PennyPost is an automated personal finance tool focused solely on spending. It analyzes spending across all connected accounts, categorizes transactions, identifies patterns and trends, runs predictions, and delivers weekly or monthly summary emails — no apps or dashboards, just emailed insight. Users plug in their accounts once and the service keeps tracking with minimal effort.
mentions.source_excerpt:
My friend and I working on PennyPost, financial analyst that solely focuses on your spending.

It looks at your spending across all your accounts, categorizes, identifies patterns, trends, runs predictions and sends weekly/monthly summary email.

No apps or dashboards, just insight.

Plug in once and forget. Takes 5 minutes to keep track of your spending.
